Department of Computer Science · North Carolina A&T

X+ Intelligence Lab.

Trustworthy intelligence for a connected world.

X+ Intelligence Lab studies trustworthy AI, mobile computing, and cybersecurity. We explore WiFi signals, cameras, acoustics, and other ubiquitous sensing modalities to protect sensitive personal data and strengthen AI systems.

Our work connects security and privacy, context-aware and explainable AI, mobile sensing, and large language models. Applications span transportation, smart homes, and agriculture, with collaborations across sociology, health, and data science.

Our research

Sensing, intelligence & trust.

Explore our directions ↗
01

Security and privacy

Fingerprinting and human biometric security, with a focus on privacy and authentication through embedded sensors in digital devices.

↗02

Trustworthy and explainable AI

Context-aware mobile systems that connect cyber-physical systems and AI for reliable, adaptive interactions.

↗03

Mobile computing

Sensing with WiFi, cameras, inertial measurement units, virtual reality, unmanned aerial vehicles, and sound for intelligent transportation and smart homes.

↗04

Large language models and NLP

Speech privacy, speech translation, and applications of large language models in agriculture and transportation.
